packageRules.description: kopf 1.39+ requires python>=3.10; ceph base image ships python3-cephfs only for system python 3.9. Unpin when ceph base bumps to a newer Stream.

Operators with upgrade/delete authority over cluster state: patch automerges, minor/major wait for a human (renovate-triage skill). rook-ceph sat 6 patches behind a CVE fix because this manager was off.

images/spilo-vchord base. Bumping it means re-checking that VectorChord is still inside the range Immich accepts, and that Spilo has not changed its shared_preload_libraries set. Only acid-immich uses this image.
oauth2-proxy gates every admin host; a bad bump locks everyone out (and it is what replaced authentik, 2026-09-23). Read the release notes, then merge by hand.

Pinned to `latest` by digest because upstream's version tags are months stale. :automergeDigest would otherwise merge a rebuild unseen, and a rebuild can move the bundled Gramps minor — desktop Gramps Web Sync only works when server and laptop agree on Gramps MAJOR.MINOR (60 today, laptop 6.0.6). Before merging, check the new image's GRAMPS_VERSION env; if it is not 60, the laptop upgrades first or sync breaks. See docs/gramps.md.

Third-party MCP server with read access to the family tree, exposed publicly behind nothing but a bearer token. :automergeDigest would otherwise pull a new build unreviewed. Read the diff — particularly anything touching MCP_AUTH_TOKEN handling, MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS (DNS-rebinding protection) or the read-only tool split — before merging.
